name: Ridge Slider
description: A slider whose track is a ridgeline: the marker climbs the path as the value changes and the readout gives the percentage and the altitude there.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the ridge, on the left.

props.name: value
props.description: How far along the route, from 0 to 100 (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting position when uncontrolled, from 0 to 100.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called continuously while the marker moves.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called when a drag or key press ends.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment between positions, in percent of the route.

props.name: points
props.description: Heights along the route at even spacing, from 0 (minAltitude) to 1 (maxAltitude). The line runs smoothly through them without overshooting. Without it a ridge is generated from seed.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the generated ridge, which climbs from the valley to the summit at the right.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the slider and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Slider.
